text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Tunku Abdul Rahman
Putra Al-Haj Pension Act, 1971.

2. Notwithstanding the Ministers (Remuneration) Ordi-
nance, 1957 or any other law pertaining to the pensions and
gratuities of Members of the Administration, Y.T.M.
Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra Al-Haj shall, on his retire-
ment from the office of Prime Minister of Malaysia, be
entitled to the following pension and privileges—

(a) a tax free gratuity of $200,000;

(b) a pension of four thousand dollars shall be payable
monthly on the first day of each month;

(c)a furnished residence shall be provided and
maintained free of charge;

(d) a government motor-car and a driver shall be
provided; and

(e) a secretary, a clerk-cum-stenographer, a security
officer and an office boy shall also be provided at
current government rates.

3. The pension and privileges set out in section 2 shall be
additional to any allowance or other privileges due to him
under any law relating to remuneration of Members of
Parliament or the Legislative Assembly of any State.

4, Any expenditure incurred under section 2 shall be paid
out of the Consolidated Fund.

5. The Emergency (Essential Powers) Ordinance No. 50,
1970 is hereby repealed.

KUALA LUMPUR
DI-CHETAK OLEH PEMANGKU PENCHETAK KERAJAAN DAN DI-TERBITKAN DENGAN PERENTAH PADA
29HB APRIL, 1971
